items.title: Why a Cboe, Citadel backed group is suing CFTC regulators
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses how a group comprised of Cboe and Citadel Securities sued US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) regulators in hopes of blocking the authorization of single-stock perpetual futures contracts.

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
